summary.para: Perform decision inference on the service.

Answer a set of named questions about an input, such as whether a customer is complaining, which team should handle a request, or how angry a customer is. The questions are defined in the task settings of the inference endpoint, and can be replaced for a single request through task_settings.
info Only the elastic service currently supports the decision task.
The unique identifier for the inference endpoint.
The input to answer the questions about. It can be specified as a string, or as an object. The object form additionally allows specifying images.
summary.code: "input": "I was charged twice for my order and nobody answers my emails."

summary.para: Task settings for the individual inference request. These settings override the task settings specified when creating the inference endpoint.
The amount of time to wait for the inference request to complete.
